# Penn State University Press

> > Penn State University Press is an academic publisher specializing in humanities, social sciences, and art history, with a strong commitment to open access through initiatives like PSU Press Unlocked.

PSU Press publishes scholarly books and journals, distributing through partnerships including Johns Hopkins University Press and the Scholarly Publishing Collective. The press features open access portals through OAPEN and Knowledge Unlatched, making scholarly work freely available to global audiences.

## Open Access Initiatives

- [Open Access Portal](https://oa.psupress.org/): Open access portal featuring scholarly books in humanities & social sciences
- [PSU Press Unlocked](https://www.psupress.org/unlocked/about.html): PSU Press Unlocked open access initiative with OAPEN & Knowledge Unlatched
